description: The accuracy set for the line being sung (D-078).
Why it exists: the interface highlights the line being sung every frame,
from the position it estimates from the anchor — it cannot ask the core
sixty times a second. So a second copy of the rule lives in JS, and two
copies drift where nobody looks: a line lit a frame early on one side only.
This file is the single source of truth both sides read. The Rust side:
The rule: the last line whose start, minus the shift, is at or before the
position. A positive shift brings the lines sooner (the LRC convention).
expected is the line's index, or null before the first line and for
